package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// ClearBeats deletes the history of the gateway the path names.
func ClearBeats(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports ClearBeatsPorts,
	in models.ClearBeatsRequest,
) (models.GatewayRef, error) {
	return ports.Registry.ClearBeats(ctx, e, in)
}
